why_agent_can_change_it: In all three traces the agent offers a human escalation that no Cartwheel policy requires, and all three orders are under the $100 threshold. support-0010 (22615bb0): a $64.75 cutting board outside the store's 14-day window; the agent offers to escalate to a human to ask for an exception. support-0210 (cd5a26ef): a merchant asks for a $36.25 order's status; after reporting it delivered, the agent offers a ticket for a missing delivery nobody reported. support-0049 (484960e7): the agent correctly declines to show another store's order, then offers to open a ticket for a human to follow up. Each offer is a sentence the agent chose to add after the request was settled or correctly refused, so the system prompt (when to offer a human), the escalate_to_human tool description, or a check on the reply in the harness can each change it.
